name: Target One: Battle Royale
summary: A realistic battle royale for PC. Up to 126 players skydive onto one island, loot real guns and armour from towns, farms and an airfield, take a car and fight until the gas leaves room for only one. No respawns, no loot beams - everything you carry has to be earned. Play solo, in duos or as a squad of four; each season your ten best matches make your rank. Dedicated servers decide every hit and item; everything for sale is cosmetic.
